conflicts.description: Two specifications targeting the same Helmfile deployment pattern with overlapping requirements

details.spec1Focus: GitOps automation, CI/CD integration, secrets management
details.spec2Focus: Multi-environment support, Istio integration, template rendering
details.overlap: Both specify Helmfile-based deployment with Istio for production

conflicts.resolution: Merge specifications into single comprehensive spec. Spec1 covers enforcement/automation, Spec2 covers validation/template correctness.

conflicts.description: Spec1 enforces Istio config in base values.yaml, but Spec2 validation shows Istio resources not rendering in production

details.spec2Actual: Production helmfile template does not render VirtualService or DestinationRule
details.rootCause: Helmfile.yaml does not conditionally load production-specific values files
details.impact: Istio enforcement changes won't take effect even if committed

conflicts.resolution: Update helmfile.yaml to conditionally load production values files: helm/charts/devbob/templates/production.values.yaml when environment=production

conflicts.description: Configuration specifies version 0.12.6 but cluster is running 0.12.5

details.impactOnSpec1: Spec1 validation skipped (no cluster), drift undetected

conflicts.resolution: Run 'helmfile sync' to align cluster state with configuration. Add drift detection to CI/CD pipeline.

conflicts.description: Both specs require devbob-secrets with overlapping keys but different requirements

details.conflict: Spec2 requires non-empty GITHUB_TOKEN for git operations, but Spec1 enforcement doesn't validate token presence

conflicts.resolution: Add secret validation to Spec1 enforcement: verify all required keys present AND non-empty. Extend validation harness to check secret completeness.

conflicts.description: Spec1 requires CI/CD automation for Helm values updates (git commit), but Spec2 shows GITHUB_TOKEN is empty, blocking git operations

details.spec1Requirement: GitHub Actions Job 4 (update-helm-values) must commit changes to git
details.spec2Blocker: GITHUB_TOKEN secret is empty (0 bytes), gh auth fails
details.impact: CI/CD automation will fail at git push step even if implemented
details.cascade: All automated PR creation, git push operations blocked

conflicts.resolution: Before implementing Spec1 CI/CD automation, ensure GITHUB_TOKEN is valid. Add pre-commit check in GitHub Actions to validate token before git operations.

conflicts.spec1: Enforces istio block in base values.yaml
conflicts.spec2: Expects production-specific values file for Istio
conflicts.resolution: Use both: base values.yaml has istio.enabled=false, production.values.yaml overrides to true

sharedComponents.recommendation: Refactor to split base configuration (values.yaml) and environment overrides (local.values.yaml, production.values.yaml)

conflicts.spec1: Assumes single values file per chart
conflicts.spec2: Requires conditional loading of environment-specific values
conflicts.resolution: Update helmfile.yaml releases to conditionally load production values files

Add Job 4 (update-helm-values) with GITHUB_TOKEN validation before git operations

conflicts.resolution: Add validation for both existence AND non-empty values

sharedComponents.recommendation: Extend validation harness to check: kubectl get secret devbob-secrets -o json | jq '.data | map_values(@base64d | length > 0)'

conflicts.spec2: Validates Istio templates render in production
conflicts.resolution: Both specs aligned - use stable names AND ensure production rendering
